product.title: Private Sightseeing to Mt. Fuji and Hakone GREEN NUMBER PLATES

description.text: In Tokyo, this private 10-hour charter leaves 23-ward hotels for Mount Fuji viewpoints or a Hakone option, not both on the same published day. The Fuji-area list includes the Subaru Line 5th Station, Lake Kawaguchiko, Oshino Hakkai, Arakurayama Sengen Park, and Chureito Pagoda, with an English-speaking driver-guide and private vehicle. Activity tickets and the Fuji entrance fee are listed separately. Weather can close the upper Subaru Line, so the driver keeps the group at the highest open station or a lake viewpoint. The format suits visitors who want a guided mountain day without self-driving the Fuji lakes. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Tokyo, and the itinerary stays on Mount Fuji, Lake Kawaguchiko, and Oshino Hakkai that shape this outing rather than a Kamakura add-on.

highlights: Private 10-hour Mount Fuji or Hakone circuit from Tokyo
Fifth Station, Lake Kawaguchiko, and Oshino Hakkai options
